content.title: Intensity Therapeutics reports positive results of INT230-6 in breast cancer
content.summary: Intensity Therapeutics (INTS) and The Swiss Group for Clinical Cancer Research or SAKK, announced that Andreas Mueller presented the final data from Intensity’s INVINCIBLE-2 Study and an overview / update of the INVINCIBLE-4 Study at the San Antonio Breast Cancer Symposium being held December 10-13 in San Antonio, Texas. The INVINCIBLE-4 Study is to determine the clinical activity, safety, and tolerability of INT230-6 in patients with early-stage, operable Triple Negative Breast Cancer, or TNBC,
